# Manpasand Store

> Pakistan’s trusted brand for premium dry fruits, dates, nuts, honey, saffron, herbs, spices, and pulses since 2000.

Website: https://www.manpasandstore.com
Brand: Manpasand Store (Karachi, Pakistan)
Contact: Contact@manpasandstore.com | +92 342 3344040

## About
Manpasand Store is a multi-location retail and online store based in Karachi with nationwide delivery across Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, Hyderabad, and more).

Physical stores:
- Bahadurabad, Karachi
- DHA Phase 4, Karachi
- Bahria Town (AQ Supermarket), Karachi

## Products
We sell premium dry fruits (almonds, cashews, pistachios, walnuts), dates (including Ajwa), saffron (zafran), honey, spices, herbs, pulses, and gift hampers.

All public pages are allowed for indexing by search engines and AI assistants. See /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml.
